'''Chain of Command''' is the 3rd virtual expansion of [[Star Trek CCG 1st Edition]]. It is published by [[The Continuing Committee]] on 6 November 2009. The set consists of 15 cards.

''Chain of Command'' is part of the ''15th Anniversary Collection''. The set features new ships and their commanders for the original three affiliations - Federation, Klingon and Romulan.
